title: oxyacantha howellii
intro: Oxyacantha howellii, commonly known as the Howell's Hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its cardiovascular benefits, as it has been traditionally used to treat heart conditions, such as high blood pressure and angina. The health benefits of Oxyacantha howellii include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and providing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, anthocyanins, and procyanidins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation and anti-inflammatory effects.
